])

# Check vertical connectivity (are any 2s directly above/below other 2s?)
vertical_neighbors = []
for r, c in np.argwhere(grid == 2):
    has_above = grid[r-1, c] == 2 if r > 0 else False
    has_below = grid[r+1, c] == 2 if r < grid.shape[0]-1 else False
    if has_above or has_below:
        vertical_neighbors.append(((r, c), has_above, has_below))

print(f"2s with vertical neighbors: {len(vertical_neighbors)}")
if vertical_neighbors:
    print("First few examples:")
    for pos, has_above, has_below in vertical_neighbors[:10]:
        print(f"  {pos}: above={has_above}, below={has_below}")

# Horizontal group sizes
horizontal_groups = {}
for i, row in enumerate(grid):
    pos_list = [j for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    groups = []
    if pos_list:
        current_group = [pos_list[0]]
        for j in range(1, len(pos_list)):
            if pos_list[j] == pos_list[j-1] + 1:
                current_group.append(pos_list[j])
            else:
                groups.append(len(current_group))
                current_group = [pos_list[j]]
        groups.append(len(current_group))
    if groups:
        horizontal_groups[i] = groups

print(f"\nRows with horizontal groups: {list(horizontal_groups.keys())}")
print(f"Group sizes by row:\n{horizontal_groups}")

# Column statistics
col_counts = {}
for c in range(grid.shape[1]):
    count = np.sum(grid[:, c] == 2)
    if count > 0:
        col_counts[c] = count

print(f"\nColumns with 2s: {sorted(col_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])}")
